digest.component_or_area: dependency advisory CI gating and resolution
propositions: committed uv lock freezes transitive dependencies, causing any future advisory on a pinned version to block all in-flight changes regardless of whether they touched the dependency map
pip-audit gate currently fails unconditionally on CRITICAL/HIGH advisories in Gerrit verify, punishing authors who did not cause the advisory and cannot fix it

uv constraint-dependencies can only narrow existing constraints and returns UNSATISFIABLE as expected output (not proof upgrade is impossible); override-dependencies is the correct remediation instrument
override-dependencies is a workspace directive not published in wheel metadata, affecting only the local lock and not downstream consumers
gate behavior must split by lane: block Gerrit verify only when the change touches the dependency map, block scheduled main runs (releases) unconditionally with escalation to ticket filing
